fields.desc: A Bedroll sleeps one Small or Medium creature. While in a Bedroll, you automatically succeed on saving throws against extreme cold (see "Gameplay Toolbox").

fields.name: Bell
fields.desc: When rung as a Utilize action, a Bell produces a sound that can be heard up to 60 feet away.

fields.name: Blanket
fields.desc: While wrapped in a blanket, you have Advantage on saving throws against extreme cold (see "Gameplay Toolbox").

fields.name: Block and Tackle
fields.desc: A Block and Tackle allows you to hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.

fields.name: Book
fields.desc: A Book contains fiction or nonfiction. If you consult an accurate nonfiction Book about its topic, you gain a +5 bonus to Intelligence (Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion) checks you make about that topic.

fields.name: Bottle, Glass
fields.desc: A Glass Bottle holds up to 1 0.5 pints.

fields.name: Bucket
fields.desc: A Bucket holds up to half a cubic foot of contents.

fields.name: Burglar's Pack
fields.desc: A Burglar's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Ball Bearings, Bell, 10 Candles, Crowbar, Hooded Lantern, 7 flasks of Oil, 5 days of Rations, Rope, Tinderbox, and Waterskin.

fields.name: Caltrops
fields.desc: As a Utilize action, you can spread Caltrops from their bag to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. A creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 1 Piercing damage and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. It takes 10 minutes to recover the Caltrops.

fields.name: Candle
fields.desc: For 1 hour, a lit Candle sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 5 feet.

fields.name: Case, Crossbow Bolt
fields.desc: A Crossbow Bolt Case holds up to 20 Bolts.

fields.name: Case, Map or Scroll
fields.desc: A Map or Scroll Case holds up to 10 sheets of paper or 5 sheets of parchment.

fields.name: Chain
fields.desc: As a Utilize action, you can wrap a Chain around an unwilling creature within 5 feet of yourself that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition if you succeed on a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Chain requires the creature to make a successful DC 18 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action. Bursting the Chain requires a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check as an action.

fields.name: Chest
fields.desc: A Chest holds up to 12 cubic feet of contents.

fields.name: Climber's Kit
fields.desc: A Climber's Kit includes boot tips, gloves, pitons, and a harness. As a Utilize action, you can use the Climber's Kit to anchor yourself; when you do, you can't fall more than 25 feet from the anchor point, and you can't move more than 25 feet from there without undoing the anchor as a Bonus Action.

fields.name: Clothes, Fine
fields.desc: Fine Clothes are made of expensive fabrics and adorned with expertly crafted details. Some events and locations admit only people wearing these clothes.

fields.name: Clothes, Traveler's
fields.desc: Traveler's Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.

fields.name: Component Pouch
fields.desc: A Component Pouch is watertight and filled with compartments that hold all the free Material components of your spells.

fields.name: Costume
fields.desc: While wearing a Costume, you have Advantage on any ability check you make to impersonate the person or type of person it represents.

fields.name: Crowbar
fields.desc: Using a Crowbar gives you Advantage on Strength checks where the Crowbar's leverage can be applied.

fields.name: Diplomat's Pack
fields.desc: A Diplomat's Pack contains the following items: Chest, Fine Clothes, Ink, 5 Ink Pens, Lamp, 2 Map or Scroll Cases, 4 flasks of Oil, 5 sheets of Paper, 5 sheets of Parchment, Perfume, and Tinderbox.

fields.name: Druidic Focus, Sprig of Mistletoe
fields.desc: A Druidic Focus is carved, tied with ribbon, or painted to channel primal magic. A Druid or Ranger can use such an object as a Spellcasting Focus.

fields.name: Druidic Focus, Wooden Staff
fields.desc: A Druidic Focus is carved, tied with ribbon, or painted to channel primal magic. A Druid or Ranger can use such an object as a Spellcasting Focus. This staff can also be used as a Quarterstaff.

fields.name: Druidic Focus, Yew Wand
fields.desc: A Druidic Focus is carved, tied with ribbon, or painted to channel primal magic. A Druid or Ranger can use such an object as a Spellcasting Focus.

fields.name: Dungeoneer's Pack
fields.desc: A Dungeoneer's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Caltrops, Crowbar, 2 flasks of Oil, 10 days of Rations, Rope, Tinderbox, 10 Torches, and Waterskin.

fields.name: Entertainer's Pack
fields.desc: An Entertainer's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Bedroll, Bell, Bullseye Lantern, 3 Costumes, Mirror, 8 flasks of Oil, 9 days of Rations, Tinderbox, and Waterskin.

fields.name: Explorer's Pack
fields.desc: An Explorer's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Bedroll, 2 flasks of Oil, 10 days of Rations, Rope, Tinderbox, 10 Torches, and Waterskin.

fields.name: Flask
fields.desc: A Flask holds up to 1 pint.

fields.name: Grappling Hook
fields.desc: As a Utilize action, you can throw the Grappling Hook at a railing, a ledge, or another catch within 50 feet of yourself, and the hook catches on if you succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. If you tied a Rope to the hook, you can then climb it.

fields.name: Healer's Kit
fields.desc: A Healer's Kit has ten uses. As a Utilize action, you can expend one of its uses to stabilize an Unconscious creature that has 0 Hit Points without needing to make a Wisdom (Medicine) check.

fields.name: Holy Symbol, Amulet)
fields.desc: A Holy Symbol Amulet is bejeweled or painted to channel divine magic. A Cleric or Paladin can use it as a Spellcasting Focus. It can be worn around the neck or held in hand.

fields.name: Holy Symbol, Emblem)
fields.desc: A Holy Symbol Emblem is bejeweled or painted to channel divine magic. A Cleric or Paladin can use it as a Spellcasting Focus. It must be borne on fabric (such as a tabard or banner) or a Shield.

fields.name: Holy Symbol, Reliquary
fields.desc: A Holy Symbol Reliquary is bejeweled or painted to channel divine magic. A Cleric or Paladin can use it as a Spellcasting Focus. It must be held in hand.

fields.name: Holy Water
fields.desc: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a flask of Holy Water. Target one creature you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or take 2d8 Radiant damage if it is a Fiend or an Undead.

fields.name: Hunting Trap
fields.desc: As a Utilize action, you can set a Hunting Trap, which is a sawtooth steel ring that snaps shut when a creature steps on a pressure plate in the center. The trap is affixed by a heavy chain to an immobile object, such as a tree or a spike driven into the ground. A creature that steps on the plate must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d4 Piercing damage and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. Thereafter, until the creature breaks free of the trap, its movement is limited by the length of the chain (typically 3 feet). A creature can use its action to make a DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Each failed check deals 1 Piercing damage to the trapped creature.

fields.name: Ink
fields.desc: Ink comes in a 1-ounce bottle, which provides enough ink to write about 500 pages.

fields.name: Ink Pen
fields.desc: Using Ink, an Ink Pen is used to write or draw.

fields.name: Jug
fields.desc: A Jug holds up to 1 gallon.

fields.name: Ladder
fields.desc: A Ladder is 10 feet tall. You must climb to move up or down it.

fields.name: Lamp
fields.desc: A Lamp burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 15 foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

fields.name: Lantern, Bullseye
fields.desc: A Bullseye Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 60-foot Cone and Dim Light for an additional 60 feet.

fields.name: Lantern, Hooded
fields.desc: A Hooded Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. As a Bonus Action, you can lower the hood, reducing the light to Dim Light in a 5-foot radius, or raise it again.

fields.name: Lock
fields.desc: A Lock comes with a key. Without the key, a creature can use Thieves' Tools to pick this Lock with a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.

fields.name: Magnifying Glass
fields.desc: A Magnifying Glass grants Advantage on any ability check made to appraise or inspect a highly detailed item. Lighting a fire with a Magnifying Glass requires light as bright as sunlight to focus, tinder to ignite, and about 5 minutes for the fire to ignite.

fields.name: Manacles
fields.desc: As a Utilize action, you can use Manacles to bind an unwilling Small or Medium creature within 5 feet of yourself that has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition if you succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. While bound, a creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls, and the creature is Restrained if the Manacles are attached to a chain or hook that is fixed in place. Escaping the Manacles requires a successful DC 20 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check as an action. Bursting them requires a successful DC 25 Strength (Athletics) check as an action. Each set of Manacles comes with a key. Without the key, a creature can use Thieves' Tools to pick the Manacles' lock with a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.

fields.name: Map
fields.desc: If you consult an accurate Map, you gain a +5 bonus to Wisdom (Survival) checks you make to find your way in the place represented on it.

fields.name: Mirror
fields.desc: A handheld steel Mirror is useful for personal cosmetics but also for peeking around corners and reflecting light as a signal.

fields.name: Net
fields.desc: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a Net. Target a creature you can see within 15 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or have the Restrained condition until it escapes. The target succeeds automatically if it is Huge or larger. To escape, the target or a creature within 5 feet of it must take an action to make a DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check, freeing the Restrained creature on a success. Destroying the Net (AC 10; 5 HP; Immunity to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage) also frees the target, ending the effect.

fields.name: Oil
fields.desc: You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below. Dousing a Creature or an Object. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra 5 Fire damage from burning oil. Dousing a Space. You can take the Utilize action to pour an Oil flask on level ground to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. If lit, the oil burns until the end of the turn 2 rounds from when the oil was lit (or 12 seconds) and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn. Fuel. Oil serves as fuel for Lamps and Lanterns. Once lit, a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern. That duration doesn't need to be consecutive; you can extinguish the burning Oil (as a Utilize action) and rekindle it again until it has burned for a total of 6 hours.

fields.name: Paper
fields.desc: One sheet of Paper can hold about 250 handwritten words.

fields.name: Parchment
fields.desc: One sheet of Parchment can hold about 250 handwritten words.

fields.name: Perfume
fields.desc: Perfume comes in a 4-ounce vial. For 1 hour after applying Perfume to yourself, you have Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to influence an Indifferent Humanoid within 5 feet of yourself.

fields.name: Poison, Basic
fields.desc: As a Bonus Action, you can use a vial of Basic Poison to coat one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition. A creature that takes Piercing or Slashing damage from the poisoned weapon or ammunition takes an extra 1d4 Poison damage. Once applied, the poison retains potency for 1 minute or until its damage is dealt, whichever comes first.

fields.name: Pole
fields.desc: A Pole is 10 feet long. You can use it to touch something up to 10 feet away. If you must make a Strength (Athletics) check as part of a High or Long Jump, you can use the Pole to vault, giving yourself Advantage on the check.

fields.name: Pot, Iron
fields.desc: An Iron Pot holds up to 1 gallon.

fields.name: Potion of Healing
fields.desc: This potion is a magic item. As a Bonus Action, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 Hit Points.

fields.name: Pouch
fields.desc: A Pouch holds up to 6 pounds within one-fifth of a cubic foot.

fields.name: Priest's Pack
fields.desc: A Priest's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Blanket, Holy Water, Lamp, 7 days of Rations, Robe, and Tinderbox.

fields.name: Quiver
fields.desc: A Quiver holds up to 20 Arrows.

fields.name: Ram, Portable
fields.desc: You can use a Portable Ram to break down doors. When doing so, you gain a +4 bonus to the Strength check. One other character can help you use the ram, giving you Advantage on this check.

fields.name: Rations
fields.desc: Rations consist of travel-ready food, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts. See "Malnutrition" in "Rules Glossary" for the risks of not eating.

fields.name: Robe
fields.desc: A Robe has vocational or ceremonial significance. Some events and locations admit only people wearing a Robe bearing certain colors or symbols.

fields.name: Rope
fields.desc: As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check. You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action.

fields.name: Sack
fields.desc: A Sack holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot.

fields.name: Scholar's Pack
fields.desc: A Scholar's Pack contains the following items: Backpack, Book, Ink, Ink Pen, Lamp, 10 flasks of Oil, 10 sheets of Parchment, and Tinderbox.

fields.name: Shovel
fields.desc: Working for 1 hour, you can use a Shovel to dig a hole that is 5 feet on each side in soil or similar material.

fields.name: Signal Whistle
fields.desc: When blown as a Utilize action, a Signal Whistle produces a sound that can be heard up to 600 feet away.

fields.name: Spell Scroll
fields.desc: A Spell Scroll (Cantrip) or Spell Scroll (Level 1) is a magic item that bears the words of a cantrip or level 1 spell, respectively, determined by the scroll's creator. If the spell is on your class's spell list, you can read the scroll and cast the spell using its normal casting time and without providing any Material components. If the spell requires a saving throw or an attack roll, the spell save DC is 13, and the attack bonus is +5. The scroll disintegrates when the casting is completed.

fields.name: Spikes, Iron
fields.desc: Iron Spikes come in bundles of ten. As a Utilize action, you can use a blunt object, such as a Light Hammer, to hammer a spike into wood, earth, or a similar material. You can do so to jam a door shut or to then tie a Rope or Chain to the Spike.

fields.name: Spyglass
fields.desc: Objects viewed through a Spyglass are magnified to twice their size.

fields.name: String
fields.desc: String is 10 feet long. You can tie a knot in it as a Utilize action.

fields.name: Tent
fields.desc: A Tent sleeps up to two Small or Medium creatures.

fields.name: Tinderbox
fields.desc: A Tinderbox is a small container holding flint, fire steel, and tinder (usually dry cloth soaked in light oil) used to kindle a fire. Using it to light a Candle, Lamp, Lantern, or Torch—or anything else with exposed fuel—takes a Bonus Action. Lighting any other fire takes 1 minute.

fields.name: Torch
fields.desc: A Torch burns for 1 hour, casting Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. When you take the Attack action, you can attack with the Torch, using it as a Simple Melee weapon. On a hit, the target takes 1 Fire damage.

fields.name: Vial
fields.desc: A Vial holds up to 4 ounces.

fields.name: Waterskin
fields.desc: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk dehydration (see "Rules Glossary").

fields.name: Alchemist's Supplies (50 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Identify a substance (DC 15), or start a fire (DC 15). Craft: Acid, Alchemist's Fire, Component Pouch, Oil, Paper, Perfume

fields.name: Brewer's Supplies (20 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Detect poisoned drink (DC 15), or identify alcohol (DC 10). Craft: Antitoxin

fields.name: Calligrapher's Supplies (10 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Write text with impressive flourishes that guard against forgery (DC 15). Craft: Ink, *Spell Scroll*

fields.name: Carpenter's Tools (8 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Strength. Utilize: Seal or pry open a door or container (DC 20). Craft: Club, Greatclub, Quarterstaff, Barrel, Chest, Ladder, Pole, Portable Ram, Torch

fields.name: Cartographer's Tools (15 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Draft a map of a small area (DC 15). Craft: Map

fields.name: Cobbler's Tools (5 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Modify footwear to give Advantage on the wearer's next Dexterity (Acrobatics) check (DC 10). Craft: Climber's Kit

fields.name: Cook's Utensils (1 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Improve food's flavor (DC 10), or detect spoiled or poisoned food (DC 15). Craft: Rations

fields.name: Glassblower's Tools (30 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Discern what a glass object held in the past 24 hours (DC 15). Craft: Glass Bottle, Magnifying Glass, Spyglass, Vial

fields.name: Jeweler's Tools (25 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Discern a gem's value (DC 15). Craft: Arcane Focus, Holy Symbol

fields.name: Leatherworker's Tools (5 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Add a design to a leather item (DC 10). Craft: Sling, Whip, Hide Armor, Leather Armor, Studded Leather Armor, Backpack, Crossbow Bolt Case, Map or Scroll Case, Parchment, Pouch, Quiver, Waterskin

fields.name: Mason's Tools (10 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Strength. Utilize: Chisel a symbol or hole in stone (DC 10). Craft: Block and Tackle

fields.name: Painter's Supplies (10 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Paint a recognizable image of something you've seen (DC 10). Craft: Druidic Focus, Holy Symbol

fields.name: Potter's Tools (10 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Discern what a ceramic object held in the past 24 hours (DC 15). Craft: Jug, Lamp

fields.name: Smith's Tools (20 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Strength. Utilize: Pry open a door or container (DC 20). Craft: Any Melee weapon (except Club, Greatclub, Quarterstaff, and Whip), Medium armor (except Hide), Heavy armor, Ball Bearings, Bucket, Caltrops, Chain, Crowbar, Firearm Bullets, Grappling Hook, Iron Pot, Iron Spikes, Sling Bullets

fields.name: Tinker's Tools (50 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Assemble a Tiny item composed of scrap, which falls apart in 1 minute (DC 20). Craft: Musket, Pistol, Bell, Bullseye Lantern, Flask, Hooded Lantern, Hunting Trap, Lock, Manacles, Mirror, Shovel, Signal Whistle, Tinderbox

fields.name: Weaver's Tools (1 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Mend a tear in clothing (DC 10), or sew a Tiny design (DC 10). Craft: Padded Armor, Basket, Bedroll, Blanket, Fine Clothes, Net, Robe, Rope, Sack, String, Tent, Traveler's Clothes

fields.name: Woodcarver's Tools (1 GP)
fields.desc: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Carve a pattern in wood (DC 10). Craft: Club, Greatclub, Quarterstaff, Ranged weapons (except Pistol, Musket, and Sling), Arcane Focus, Arrows, Bolts, Druidic Focus, Ink Pen, Needles

fields.name: Disguise Kit
fields.desc: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Apply makeup (DC 10). Craft: Costume

fields.name: Forgery Kit
fields.desc: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Mimic 10 or fewer words of someone else's handwriting (DC 15), or duplicate a wax seal (DC 20)

fields.name: Gaming Set, Dice
fields.desc: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Discern whether someone is cheating (DC 10), or win the game (DC 20)

fields.name: Gaming Set, Dragonchess
fields.desc: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Discern an opponent's mood and intentions (DC 15), or win the game (DC 20)

fields.name: Gaming Set, Playing Cards
fields.desc: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Discern an opponent's mood and intentions (DC 15), or win the game (DC 20)

fields.name: Gaming Set, Three-Dragon Ante
fields.desc: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Discern an opponent's mood and intentions (DC 15), or win the game (DC 20)

fields.name: Herbalism Kit
fields.desc: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Identify a plant (DC 15). Craft: Antitoxin, Potion of Healing

fields.name: Musical Instrument, Bagpipes
fields.desc: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Identify a musical piece (DC 15)

fields.name: Musical Instrument, Drum
fields.desc: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Identify a musical piece (DC 15)

fields.name: Musical Instrument, Dulcimer
fields.desc: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Identify a musical piece (DC 15)

fields.name: Musical Instrument, Flute
fields.desc: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Identify a musical piece (DC 15)

fields.name: Musical Instrument, Lute
fields.desc: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Identify a musical piece (DC 15)

fields.name: Musical Instrument, Lyre
fields.desc: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Identify a musical piece (DC 15)

fields.name: Musical Instrument, Horn
fields.desc: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Identify a musical piece (DC 15)

fields.name: Musical Instrument, Pan Flute
fields.desc: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Identify a musical piece (DC 15)

fields.name: Musical Instrument, Shawm
fields.desc: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Identify a musical piece (DC 15)

fields.name: Musical Instrument, Viol
fields.desc: Ability: Charisma. Utilize: Identify a musical piece (DC 15)

fields.name: Navigator's Tools
fields.desc: Ability: Wisdom. Utilize: Plot a course (DC 15), or determine position (DC 15)

fields.name: Poisoner's Kit
fields.desc: Ability: Intelligence. Utilize: Detect a poisoned object (DC 10). Craft: Basic Poison

fields.name: Thieves' Tools
fields.desc: Ability: Dexterity. Utilize: Pick a lock (DC 15), or disarm a trap (DC 15)

fields.name: Camel
fields.desc: A desert-dwelling mount capable of carrying heavy loads.

fields.name: Elephant
fields.desc: A massive mount capable of carrying extremely heavy loads.

fields.name: Horse (Draft)
fields.desc: A strong horse bred for pulling heavy loads.

fields.name: Horse (Riding)
fields.desc: A horse trained for riding and carrying moderate loads.

fields.name: Mastiff
fields.desc: A large dog trained for combat and carrying small loads.

fields.name: Mule
fields.desc: A sturdy mount known for its reliability and carrying capacity.

fields.name: Pony
fields.desc: A small horse suitable for smaller riders and lighter loads.

fields.name: Warhorse
fields.desc: A horse trained for combat and carrying heavy loads.

fields.name: Carriage
fields.desc: A four-wheeled vehicle pulled by horses, designed for passenger transport.

fields.name: Cart
fields.desc: A two-wheeled vehicle pulled by a single horse, designed for cargo transport.

fields.name: Chariot
fields.desc: A two-wheeled vehicle pulled by horses, designed for speed and combat.

fields.name: Feed (per day)
fields.desc: Daily feed for a mount.

fields.name: Saddle (Exotic)
fields.desc: A saddle designed for unusual mounts, such as aquatic or flying creatures.

fields.name: Saddle (Military)
fields.desc: A saddle designed for combat, providing advantage on checks to remain mounted.

fields.name: Saddle (Riding)
fields.desc: A standard saddle for riding mounts.

fields.name: Sled
fields.desc: A vehicle designed for travel over snow and ice.

fields.name: Wagon
fields.desc: A four-wheeled vehicle pulled by horses, designed for heavy cargo transport.

fields.name: Airship
fields.desc: A magical flying vessel capable of air travel.

fields.name: Galley
fields.desc: A large warship propelled by oars and sails.

fields.name: Keelboat
fields.desc: A small riverboat with a keel.

fields.name: Longship
fields.desc: A swift ship designed for raiding and exploration.

fields.name: Rowboat
fields.desc: A small boat propelled by oars.

fields.name: Sailing Ship
fields.desc: A large ship propelled by sails.

fields.name: Warship
fields.desc: A heavily armed ship designed for naval combat.
